class="hero-intro">Find your feet. Catch the wind. Meet a whole new side of La Ventana.</p><div class="hero-actions"><a class="button light" href="https://wa.me/526122003779?text=%C2%A1Hola%20ChiloChill%21%20Me%20gustar%C3%ADa%20saber%20m%C3%A1s%20sobre%20clases%20de%20kitesurf" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Plan your lessons<span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></div></section><section class="wrap section"><div class="section-head"><div><p class="eyebrow">YOUR NEXT GOOD OBSESSION</p><h2><span>From first steps</span><span><br/>to</span><span> <em>fresh challenges.</em></span></h2></div><p>Our team helps you find the right lesson for your level. Staying somewhere else? You can still join us on the water.</p></div><div class="lesson-grid lesson-custom-plan"><article><span class="lesson-hours">01</span><h3><span>New to the wind</span></h3><p>Get to know the equipment, build confidence and take your first steps with an instructor.</p><a class="text-link" href="https://wa.me/526122003779?text=%C2%A1Hola%20ChiloChill%21%20Me%20gustar%C3%ADa%20saber%20m%C3%A1s%20sobre%20Tu%20primer%20vuelo" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ask our team<span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></article><article><span class="lesson-hours">02</span><h3><span>Find your flow</span></h3><p>Keep progressing with lessons shaped around your experience and the conditions.</p><a class="text-link" href="https://wa.me/526122003779?text=%C2%A1Hola%20ChiloChill%21%20Me%20gustar%C3%ADa%20saber%20m%C3%A1s%20sobre%20Encuentra%20tu%20ritmo" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ask our team<span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></article><article><span class="lesson-hours">03</span><h3><span>Stay. Kite. Repeat.</span></h3><p>Make ChiloChill your base. Ask us about combining your glamping stay with lessons.</p><a class="text-link" href="https://wa.me/526122003779?text=%C2%A1Hola%20ChiloChill%21%20Me%20gustar%C3%ADa%20saber%20m%C3%A1s%20sobre%20Duerme.%20Navega.%20Repite." target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ask our team<span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></article></div></section><section class="wrap section faq-layout"><div><p class="eyebrow">BEFORE YOU GET ON THE WATER</p><h2><span>Good questions.</span><span><br/><em>Clear answers.</em></span></h2></div><div class="faq-list"><details><summary>Do I need experience?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><div><div class="content-prose "><div class="payload-richtext"><p>No. Ask for a beginner lesson and tell the team your experience level when arranging your session.</p></div></div></div></details><details><summary>How much do lessons cost?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><div><div class="content-prose "><div class="payload-richtext"><p>Our team will confirm current lesson options, duration, inclusions and rates before you book.</p></div></div></div></details><details><summary>What if the wind changes?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><div><div class="content-prose "><div class="payload-richtext"><p>Kitesurfing depends on the conditions. Confirm scheduling and weather-related changes with the school when booking.</p></div></div></div></details></div></section><section class="wrap section"><div class="section-head"><div><h2><span>Lessons at</span><span><br/><em>your pace.</em></span></h2></div><p>IKO-certified instruction. Ask about instruction in English, Spanish, German or French for your dates.</p></div><div class="lesson-grid lesson-duration-grid"><article><span class="lesson-hours">3 h</span><h3><span>Build your session plan</span></h3><p>Confirm availability, level, lesson format and a current quote with our team.</p></article><article><span class="lesson-hours">6 h</span><h3><span>Build your session plan</span></h3><p>Confirm availability, level, lesson format and a current quote with our team.</p></article><article><span class="lesson-hours">9 h</span><h3><span>Build your session plan</span></h3><p>Confirm availability, level, lesson format and a current quote with our team.</p></article><article><span class="lesson-hours">12 h</span><h3><span>Build your session plan</span></h3><p>Confirm availability, level, lesson format and a current quote with our team.</p></article></div></section><section class="wrap section intro-split" id="foiling"><div><h2><span>More ways</span><span><br/>to</span><span> <em>ride.</em></span></h2></div><div><div class="content-prose "><div class="payload-richtext"><p>Ask about wingfoiling and foil progression, or explore a tow-foil session.
